weekly_objective: Absorb three rising load weeks (W39-W41, peaking at 848) by cutting load about 35%, keeping Tuesday's committed hard double as the only intensity and restarting strength with one maintenance session.
coach_says: This is a planned recovery week. Load has climbed three weeks in a row to 848, about 74% above your previous 4-week average, so we're cutting volume about 35% even though HRV (7-day 48.5 vs 47.3 baseline), resting HR (+1.7 bpm) and sleep (8.1 h) all look good. Tuesday's hills ride and MTB group ride stay as your one hard day, but keep the morning controlled and stay safe on soaked roads and trails. The gym has been skipped in favour of extra MTB lately, so it moves to Thursday lunch as one short session; please resist turning easy days into bonus rides this week.

days.details:
50 min | Recovery spin before Tuesday's double | Z1-2, RPE 2-3
Steady Z1-2 on smooth trails or fire roads, no hard climbs or efforts
Include 3x10 s relaxed high-cadence spin-ups in the last 15 min
Hot afternoon (up to 34°C): carry a full bottle with electrolytes

days.session: Committed double: AM hills (controlled) + PM hard MTB group ride
days.details:
AM road hills: 75 min | Aerobic climbing, save legs for PM | Z2, climbs capped at Z3 (RPE 5-6)
Warm up 15 min Z1-2
Ride the usual hill loop with climbs seated at Z3 max, no surges over the top; Z2 between climbs
Cool down 10 min Z1
Heavy rain (14.5 mm): lights, wider tyres if possible, brake early on descents. If roads are flooded, ride 60 min on the trainer with 4x6 min Z3 at 70-80 rpm, 4 min Z2 recovery.
PM MTB group ride: ~90 min | Hard group effort | Z4-5 on climbs per group pace
Ride the group efforts as they come, ease into Z2 on regroups
Wet trails: ride the technical sections conservatively
Fuelling: about 60 g carbs/h on the PM ride plus a carb-rich meal between rides; recovery meal with 25-30 g protein after.
days.fallback: If HRV is well below baseline, RHR is 5+ bpm high or sleep was poor: make the AM ride 45 min Z1-2 on the trainer with no climbs. Still ride the PM group ride, but sit in, skip the attacks and cap at Z3 where the group allows.

days.details: 40 min gentle flow: hip flexors, glutes, hamstrings, thoracic rotation and lower back; finish with 5 min breathing. No riding today (recovery constraint and thunderstorms forecast).

Workout A:
Warm-up: 5 min easy bike or rower, then leg swings, glute bridges and 2 ramp-up sets of squats
Back Squat 2x5 (conservative load after missed sessions, 2-3 RIR)
Romanian Deadlift 2x6 (2-3 RIR)
Pull-up 2x6 (assisted if needed, 2 RIR)
Single-Leg Glute Bridge 2x10/side
Dead Bug 2x8/side
Side Plank 2x30s/side
Rest: 2-3 min between heavy sets, 60 s between stability sets
Objective: Restart heavy lower-body strength with half volume and no soreness carried into the weekend.
days.fallback: If recovery signals are poor: drop squats and RDLs and do 25 min of mobility plus core work only (dead bug, side plank, glute bridge).

days.details:
Warmup: 200 m easy (100 free, 50 back, 50 drill)
Main set: 6x100 m aerobic freestyle at RPE 4-5, 20 s rest
Cooldown: 200 m easy mixed strokes
Total: 1000 m
Objective: Low-impact aerobic flush and variety on a wet day without adding riding load.

75 min | Easy aerobic trail ride | Z2, RPE 3-4
Steady Z2, spin up climbs in an easy gear, keep it conversational
No group hammering or Strava efforts this week
Light drizzle: pick trails that drain well

135 min | Aerobic endurance, reduced for recovery week | Z2, RPE 3-4
Steady Z2 throughout, last 15 min Z1
Cadence 85-95, no tempo blocks
Driest day of the week (1.8 mm), but use mudguards and lights
Fuelling: 50-60 g carbs/h from 30 min in, 1 bottle/h
